notes: Pharo's Spotter answers one question — *where is the thing I am thinking of* — across every kind an image holds. This browser had all the parts (classes, selectors, implementors, senders, packages, source) and no front door: you had to know *which kind* your answer was before you could look for it, which is exactly what you don't know when you're looking for something. THE RANKING IS ACCOUNTABLE, AND THAT IS THE POINT. A ranked list whose order nobody can explain is one that has quietly made the decision for you.
